preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n1 and 1 <= vi <= n2 for ui, vi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (ui, vi) must have ui in [1, n1] and vi in [1, n2], where n1 and n2 are the sizes of the two partitions.
The number of edges m must exactly match the count of provided edges.
The input sizes n1, n2, and m must satisfy 1 ≤ n1, n2 ≤ 2000 and 0 ≤ m ≤ 2000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == 1 + cntk for line in output_lines if (cntk := int(line[0])) >= 0)
postconditions.description: Each output line must start with cntk (number of edges in the minimal k-covering), followed by cntk distinct edge indices (1-based).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= edge_idx <= m for line in output_lines for edge_idx in line[1:] if line)
postconditions.description: Each edge index in the output must be a valid edge index from 1 to m.

postconditions.expression: all(set(line[1:]) == set(edge_indices) for line, edge_indices in zip(output_lines, minimal_coverings))
postconditions.description: The output must exactly match the computed minimal k-coverings for each k from 0 to minDegree.

postconditions.expression: all(len(covering) == min_size for covering, min_size in zip(minimal_coverings, minimal_sizes))
postconditions.description: The size of each minimal k-covering must be minimal possible for the given k.

postconditions.expression: all(all(degree[vertex] >= k for vertex in vertices) for k, covering in enumerate(minimal_coverings, start=0) for degree in vertex_degrees(covering))
postconditions.description: For each k, the minimal k-covering must ensure every vertex in the graph has degree at least k in the subgraph induced by the covering.
